page.overview:
Who is Movincihawk?

Powerplex Guardians of the Globe Capes Inc. Main Debbie Grayson (attempted victim) Angstrom Levy (former ally)

Nolan Grayson (father) Debbie Grayson † (mother; victim)

Movincihawk is a supporting antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 3. He is an evil variant of main Invincible from another universe, where he rose to power through sheer brutality.

Movincihawk was assembled by Angstrom Levy to help start the Invincible War in the mainstream dimension. After the war, he and the surviving variants turned on Angstrom for breaking their deal and were subsequently banished to the Wasteland Universe.
